sentence: This project builds a preclinical imaging informatics platform and sets up a center for managing and sharing imaging data.
This project studies how differences between single cells affect the progression of bacterial vaginosis in human microbial communities.
This project tries to find out when mutations arise inside cells, what happens to them as we age, and whether they can be removed.
This project combines clinical review tools, sequencing and functional genomics to diagnose patients with undiagnosed and rare diseases.
This project studies what the protein ubiquitin E3 ligase does when it is mutated in mantle cell lymphoma.
This project studies how a cellular pathway changes tau levels and aggregation in Alzheimer disease and related tauopathies.
This project follows smokers over time, using imaging, physiology and molecular data, to find what drives chronic obstructive pulmonary disease to progress.
This project tries to find out how influenza virus helps Staphylococcus aureus cause severe lung disease.
This project develops a drug-like molecule that blocks a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor to study the receptor's role in neuropathic pain.
This project studies how bacteria in the human gut microbiome colonize the gut and regulate intestinal inflammation.
This project improves a diagnostic tool for rare genetic diseases in children, using long-read sequencing and machine learning.
This project looks for RNA binding proteins that matter for hematopoietic stem cells and studies their targets.
This project uses machine learning to predict which patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment will improve from cognitive training.
This project builds a rapid test that measures RNA levels in single cells to check antimicrobial susceptibility of gonorrhea bacteria.
This project tests whether a homecare team that targets social determinants of health improves stroke outcomes.
This project studies how oxidative damage to DNA produces faulty RNA and proteins in heart cells and builds DNA repair systems to remove it.
This project uses single-cell sequencing on patient samples and mouse models to find why myeloproliferative neoplasms resist interferon-alfa treatment.
This project uses mouse models to study how pregnancy changes the mammary gland and how this affects an oncogene and breast cancer risk.
This project studies how chromatin remodeling drives inflammation in endothelial cells and promotes macrophage adhesion in atherosclerosis.
This project tests how changing cholesterol removal in vascular smooth muscle cells in arteries affects atherosclerosis.
